summary: Validated public employee self-serve signup + employer approval workflow end-to-end. Backend: 16/16 new signup tests pass + 33/33 regression tests still green (49/49 total). Frontend: /signup page renders with all 12 required data-testids; employer dropdown loads tenants from /auth/employers; password show/hide toggle works; captcha refresh works; consent enforcement blocks submit and shows error; on success signup-success view renders. Privacy modal contains 'Noratech Private Limited' as required. Login page has signup link routing to /signup. Employer Employees page (/employer/employees) shows pending-signups-panel ABOVE active employees list (top y=163 vs 546) with 4 pending-row-{id} entries and matching approve-signup-{id} / reject-signup-{id} buttons; approve modal opens with approve-signup-submit + emp_code + monthly_salary fields.

issues: Joining date field uses native browser <input type="date"> picker rather than shadcn Calendar component — minor inconsistency with the rest of the app's date pickers (if any). Cosmetic only; not blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: auth.py /auth/signup: ordering is correct (consent check before captcha consume) — good, prevents wasting captchas on consent-less calls.
employees.py route ordering (/employees/pending before /employees/{employee_id}) is preserved as required by FastAPI matching.

approve_signup uses default param `req: ApproveSignupRequest = ApproveSignupRequest()` — Pydantic model as default is risky (mutable default antipattern). Works in practice because each call creates a fresh instance via dependency injection, but switch to `req: ApproveSignupRequest | None = None` and instantiate inside if you want bullet-proof safety.
Signup creates placeholder emp_code `NEW-XXXXXX`. If employer approves WITHOUT supplying emp_code, the placeholder persists — confirmed acceptable by spec, but worth a UI hint.
_consume_captcha now has a tiny race: a wrong-answer call marks captcha consumed (good), but raises 400 only AFTER the update. Order is intentional (anti-bruteforce). OK.
Frontend Signup.jsx: relies on tenant list from /auth/employers which is fully public — exposes all tenant names. By design (SaaS distribution), but consider rate-limiting eventually.
Approve modal Joining date input is native HTML5 — consider unifying with shadcn Calendar for consistency.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Signup + approval workflow fully covered in /app/backend/tests/test_signup_flow.py (16 tests, stateful, order-sensitive). Reuses the NoraTech tenant by matching employer's tenant_id from login (the public employers list contains many TEST_ tenants from prior runs — DO NOT pick the first 'nora' match blindly). Email is lowercased server-side, so always compare in lowercase. Employer pending list endpoint /api/employees/pending exists at correct route order before /api/employees/{id}. Frontend signup-success state requires both consent=true AND fresh captcha — captchas are single-use, so refresh after any failed submit. Signup tests leave ~4 pending residual rows for the NoraTech employer; cleanup script could reject them all if cleaner runs are needed.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Initial test failures during development were author-side: assertions compared against original-case email but server lowercases emails on signup — fixed in test by comparing email.lower().
